identity_rules.placement_identity_location: actual cloud location: AWS region, Azure region, GCP zone
identity_rules.placement_identity_resource: actual native resource identity; opaque Outrider allocation ID is a separate journal key
identity_rules.attribution: controller tag plus exact journal name/native scope; pool tag alone does not grant ownership
identity_rules.unknown: lookup outage/invalid ownership/inconclusive mapping must not become empty or absent
identity_rules.incarnation_before_name_mutation: Azure resource-group/name and GCP name/zone-name locators can be reused. Before lifecycle mutation or attributing Get/List under an existing opaque allocation, independently verify retained native scope/ID/controller/pool and Azure vmId or GCP numericID+name. Missing, changed incarnation or failed lookup cannot authorize mutation/adoption of a replacement.
identity_rules.stock_child_race_limit: Unmodified child name-addressed APIs provide no atomic native-incarnation precondition. Read verification is required; concurrent out-of-band replacement between verification and child mutation remains an operator ownership boundary, not a claimed atomic guarantee.

list_filters: tag:Name when a name is requested

azure.incarnation: properties.vmId; preserve separately from reusable ARM path

gcp.native_child_provider_id: name in zonal mode; zone/name in qualified regional mode
